name: Spider Bomb and Firepot Drone carry a resolvable owner for damage attribution (#9511)
contract: Build: Spider Bomb 500535 and Build: Firepot Drone 500600 summon a device (entry 226012/226112) through
the shared Summon() helper in AscensionTinkerSummons.cpp. That helper called player->SummonCreature()
with no SummonProperties, leaving the device's UNIT_FIELD_SUMMONEDBY empty, so damage meters could not
trace its explosion damage back to the Tinker even though the ability otherwise worked. The native
GetOwnedCreature() lookup (owned_creature_display metric) requires creature->GetOwnerGUID() == player,
exactly the field this fix populates, so it only returns the device's display (nonzero) once the owner

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Spider Bomb carries a resolvable owner link (UNIT_FIELD_SUMMONEDBY) to the Tinker
Let the device detonate and despawn before the next build
Firepot Drone carries a resolvable owner link (UNIT_FIELD_SUMMONEDBY) to the Tinker
